---
title: "NBA Salary Analysis"
format: html
---

Libraries

```{r,message=FALSE }
library(car)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmnet)
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
library(corrplot)
```

Importing data and some basic data wrangling for feature engineering

```{r, message=FALSE}

nba <- vroom::vroom("nba_cleaned.csv")|>
    separate(Height, into = c("feet", "inches"), sep = "-", convert = TRUE)|>
    mutate(Weight = as.numeric(str_extract(Weight, "\\d+")),
        Country = ifelse(Country == "USA", "American", "Foreign"),
        Height = (feet * 12) + inches)|>
    select(-Player, -feet, -inches,- PlayerScore, -College, -Position, -Team)
nba[302, "Weight"] <- 201

```

EDA and Assumptions

```{r}
head(nba)
base_lm <- lm((Salary)~Weight + Age + `X3P.` + `X2P.` +
                 `eFG.` + Rebs + AST + STL + BLK +
                 Fouls + PTS + Height, data = nba)

avPlots(base_lm,
        terms = ~ Weight + Age + `X3P.` + `X2P.` +
                 `eFG.` + Rebs + AST + STL + BLK +
                 Fouls + PTS + Height)

```

Trying log transform for salary

```{r}
log_lm <- lm(log(Salary) ~ ., data = nba)
bptest(log_lm)

```

```{r}
cor_matrix <- cor(nba[sapply(nba, is.numeric)],
                  use = "complete.obs")

corrplot(cor_matrix,
         method = "color",
         type = "upper",
         addCoef.col = "black",
         tl.col = "black",
         tl.srt = 45)
```

Lasso- Originally I tried it with all interactions as well but I found that the regular model with no interactions was easier to interpret and not statistically significantly different.

```{r}
x <- model.matrix((Salary) ~ ., data = nba)[, -1] 
y <- log(nba$Salary)

# 2. Run Cross-Validation to find the optimal penalty (lambda)
# alpha = 1 specifies LASSO
cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 1)
best_lambda <- cv_lasso$lambda.min

# 3. Fit the final model
lasso_model <- glmnet(x, y, alpha = 1, lambda = best_lambda)

# 4. View which interactions the LASSO kept (non-zero coefficients)
coef_list <- coef(lasso_model, s = "lambda.min")
coef_list
```

Reggression with Lasso Selected Coefficients

```{r}

lasso_lm <- lm(
  log(Salary) ~
    Age + Rebs + STL + BLK + Fouls + PTS
,
  data = nba
)

summary(lasso_lm)
```

Testing lasso_lm and comparing to the log model

```{r}
plot(lasso_lm, which =1)
bptest(lasso_lm)
anova(log_lm, lasso_lm)
```

Heteroscedastic model - adjusting the standard errors based on its hetereoscedasticity.

```{r}
coeftest(log_lm, vcov = vcovHC(lasso_lm, type = "HC3"))
```
